subject.title: policy: repair required deny tool findings

question: Should `doctor --fix` be allowed to automatically add required tool ids to `tools.deny` and `agents.list[].tools.deny` under the existing `workspaceRepairs=true` opt-in?
rationale: The implementation appears bounded and tested, but it intentionally changes security-sensitive user config during repair, which is a maintainer policy choice rather than a pure correctness issue.

options.title: Accept the gated repair
options.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms the workspaceRepairs opt-in, scoped inherited-root skip, and regression coverage are the intended policy boundary.

options.title: Keep it review-only
options.body: Change required-deny findings back to detect-only or preview-only if automatic deny-list mutation is too strong for current policy repair UX.

options.title: Narrow the mutation surface
options.body: Allow only agent-local repairs or only global repairs if maintainers want a smaller first step before downstream policy repair slices land.

recommendation.title: Accept the gated repair
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms the workspaceRepairs opt-in, scoped inherited-root skip, and regression coverage are the intended policy boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed the exact scoped repair risk and are the clearest routing candidate for the maintainer acceptance question in the available discussion.
